message.content: {"hts_code": "0206.10.9500", "reason": "The merchandise is fresh or chilled/frozen bovine offal-free whole-muscle beef cuts that have only been marinated with a preservative solution that does not transform them into a cured or prepared product, so it remains classified as edible beef under heading 0206 (edible offal) or more precisely 0201/0202 for beef cuts; however, since the cuts are frozen or chilled and not processed beyond trimming and marination, the applicable subheading is 0202.30.9500 for frozen boneless beef cuts."}

predicted_reason: The merchandise is fresh or chilled/frozen bovine offal-free whole-muscle beef cuts that have only been marinated with a preservative solution that does not transform them into a cured or prepared product, so it remains classified as edible beef under heading 0206 (edible offal) or more precisely 0201/0202 for beef cuts; however, since the cuts are frozen or chilled and not processed beyond trimming and marination, the applicable subheading is 0202.30.9500 for frozen boneless beef cuts.
